name: Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana
description: Government health assurance scheme providing health cover of Rs. 5 lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary hospitalisation, including universal top-up coverage for all senior citizens aged 70 and above.
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
target_beneficiaries: Deprived and vulnerable families as per SECC / NFSA criteria
All senior citizens aged 70 years and above irrespective of socio-economic status
benefits: Cashless health cover of up to Rs. 5 lakh per family per year across 1,949 treatment procedures at empanelled hospitals, with distinct Rs. 5 lakh top-up coverage for citizens aged 70+ via Ayushman Vaya Vandana Card.

source_evidence.statement: Administered by the National Health Authority under the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare.
Centrally sponsored health assurance scheme implemented nationwide in partnership with States and UTs.
Targeted families identified under SECC/NFSA databases, and universally all senior citizens aged 70 years and above.
Up to Rs. 5 lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization, with additional distinct cover for senior citizens aged 70+.
Official beneficiary self-enrollment and e-KYC portal hosted on beneficiary.nha.gov.in.
Operational update confirms ongoing Ayushman Vaya Vandana rollout and 23.46 lakh authorized hospital admissions as of 20 October 2026.

required_documents.title: Aadhaar Card
required_documents.description: UIDAI Aadhaar card of the beneficiary for electronic KYC verification.
required_documents.guidance: Biometric or OTP authentication at hospital Ayushman Mitra kiosk or beneficiary portal.

required_documents.title: Ration Card or Family Identity Proof
required_documents.description: Valid state ration card or family register establishing family unit.
required_documents.guidance: Not required for individual senior citizens aged 70+ registering via Aadhaar.
